resolution.note: Stop names a missing test root, a lane whose merged PR outlived its worktree passes, a brief line 'Delivery: none' spares non-delivery lanes; each proven in test/hook/stop.test.ts

title: Stop check names a missing test root and spares non-delivery lanes
body:
Source: 2026-11-17 research lanes for t-tpkc9xz: three lanes reported their Stop check failing with `spawnSync .../node/24.22.1/bin/node ENOENT` while that node exists; spawnSync reports ENOENT on the program when its cwd is missing (src/hook/stop.ts runTests answers `<run>::error <message>`). The lanes also could not finish because a non-delivery lane has no commit or PR.
Outcome: when the Stop check's test root does not exist it names the missing directory instead of the program, and a lane brief can mark itself non-delivery so its Stop check does not demand a commit, PR or test run.
Proof: node --test test/hook/stop.test.ts with a case whose root is removed asserts the message names the directory.
